capability: When parts don't fit, add a named converter
title: Add the missing piece.

hook.picture: Close on the whale pushing two grey cards together on the line; one ends in a round socket, the other starts with a square one.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: Each tool works. Chained together, they fall apart.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: learner wiring two AI tools together in a course lab

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: a long chain of cards with cracks at every join. Three more joins are forced, every 2 beats, then 1, then half; each cracks.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Each tool speaks its own format.

stakes.body: Hours lost forcing joins, and a chain that breaks the moment one tool changes its output.

solution_hint: Don't jam it. Put a converter between.

metaphor.body: Two cards meet with sockets of different shapes; instead of jamming them, a small two-sided card that fits each side slides between them, a named converter.

steps.picture: The sockets show colour: the left card gives seashell pink, the right card needs deep green. The mismatch is plain.
steps.sound: Two tuned knocks a step apart

steps.picture: The whale holds the two cards apart.
steps.words: Match what one gives to what next needs.

steps.picture: A small two-sided card, pink on one face and green on the other, slides between them.
Push-in: both ends snap; a tick lands at each join.
steps.words: No match? Add a named converter card.

steps.picture: The same converter card is reused at another pink-to-green join further along; it snaps there too.
The converters glow along the chain.

real_case.claim: Operad of design units, Law 1: compose only when types match, otherwise insert a named adapter; the estate needs four, and colour is written six incompatible ways today.

source.title: The operad of design units (GenUI Studio Research Wiki)

honest_limit.picture: A pink card carrying a wrong value inside (a copper smudge in its lines) passes through the converter, comes out green, and snaps cleanly.
honest_limit.words: It converts the shape. Not the mistake.

not_this.body: A good fit can carry bad values.

ending_pattern.body: FELT framing: the same join where the line cracked. Now a steady stream of cards flows across the converter without a crack, and the pod downstream answers with a tick.
ending_pattern.callback: The join that cracked twice in bars 2 and 3 now carries a stream, in the same close framing.

end_belief.body: When parts don't fit, name the converter.
